items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 16:1
items.html: The illumination of the Malchut of the first restriction is called Botsina deKardinus, and its beginning is in the Gevura of Atik, for this Malchut is found only in Atik, and it is the root of the Gevurot of the worlds. For the Gevurot in ABYA are only from the second restriction, which is only a branch of the first restriction, as is known. And this Gevura of Atik is clothed in the Sealed Brain, and the aspect of the Hod of Atik is clothed in the two ears, in the secret of the two male testicles, as all this was written above in Answer 12; see there. (Page 319, Item 57).
